brief: Finds, counts and removes the repeated items of a list: positions of the repeats, items that repeat, items that never do, and the most repeated one.
detail: It is the repeats helper of stzList, which builds one over itself for its ContainsDuplicatedItemsCS and DuplicatedItemsCS methods; build one with new stzListDuplicates when you need the rest. It works on its own copy, so a stzList passed in is never changed, and you read the result of an in-place verb (RemoveDuplicates) with Content. A repeat is an occurrence after the first one of its item, so the first occurrence is never a duplicate: on a b a c b a d the repeats sit at positions 3, 5 and 6, and NumberOfDuplicates is 3. Every question has a CS form taking 1 to compare with case and 0 to ignore it. ItemsDuplicatedNTimes and MostDuplicatedItem give the items back as texts, so the number 3 is "3". RemoveNthDuplicate does nothing today. Hebrew, Arabic and emoji items repeat like any other text.
